Every first-version requirement maps to planned work. Letter labels are provisional; Storybloq will assign ticket IDs during setup.

| Requirement | Source | Tickets | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Teacher can find a book by title or author | Your first-version scope; README | C: Search API; F: Browser workflow | Matching, empty-query, and no-match tests; teacher searches in the browser |
| Teacher can lend a book to a pupil | Your first-version scope | D: Lending; F: Browser workflow | Loan records pupil and due date; concurrent double lending is rejected |
| Teacher can record a return | Your first-version scope | D, F | Returned copy becomes available; repeated return is harmless |
| Teacher can see overdue books | Your first-version scope | E: Overdue query; F | Yesterday’s active loans appear; loans due today and returned loans do not |
| Nothing is lost on restart | Your first-version scope | B: Durable storage; D; F | Restart and forced-interruption tests preserve acknowledged changes; retries avoid duplicates |
| One teacher operates the app; pupils do not | Your users statement | F | Complete teacher-operated journey, with no pupil login or pupil interface |
| Keep the existing technology | Your technology constraint | B–F | Node.js and JavaScript retained; browser uses plain HTML/CSS/JS |
| Existing catalogue listing and addition | `src/books.js`, `src/server.js` | A: Existing baseline; C and F extend it | A is source-verified only; new API and browser behavior receives tests |
| Teacher reviews the working workflow | Proposed owner checkpoint | G, after F | Demonstration with synthetic data, including empty, failure, and restart cases |
| Owner accepts the first version | Proposed owner checkpoint | H, after G | Acceptance against all five outcomes: find, lend, return, overdue, persistence |

The following are **proposed implementation assumptions**, using the judgment you delegated:

| Assumption or supporting concern | Coverage |
|---|---|
| One catalogue record represents one physical copy | C, D |
| Teacher supplies the due date; overdue means before the server’s local calendar day | D, E |
| Local workstation deployment and local file storage | B, F |
| Safe retry after an uncertain save; prevent competing writers | B, C, D, F |
| Minimal pupil data; remove labels after return, exclude them from replay records, clear resolved browser recovery data | B, D, F |
| Document backup retention separately from deletion of current data | B, F |
| Accessible controls and clear loading, empty, error, and recovery states | F |

No requested first-version capability is deferred. Public hosting, pupil accounts, reminders, fines, reservations, and barcode integrations are outside the proposed scope.

The package is unchanged. The final review’s pupil-data retention clarification remains incorporated into the proposed ticket requirements but has not been independently re-reviewed.
